english.title: Fail to comply with provision of statement of affairs where administrative receiver appointed
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been appointed as the administrative receiver of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), without reasonable excuse, failed forthwith to require some or all of those persons mentioned in section 47(3) of the Insolvency Act 1986 to make out and submit to you a statement in the prescribed form as to the affairs of the company
english.legislation: Contrary to section 47(1) and (6) of, and Schedule 10 to, the Insolvency Act 1986.

english.notes:
(i) Section 47 above does not apply where theappointment is for him to act with an existing administrative receiver, or inplace of one who has died or ceased to act if they have been complied withprior to the previous one dying or ceasing to act.
(ii) If the company is being wound up section 47 applies, with any necessarymodifications, even if the administrative receiver and the liquidator are thesame person.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum or a fine not exceeding one-tenth of the statutory maximum for each day on which the act or the failure continues.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
